field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_DoyouhaveSARprocedureinplace
field.label: Do you have SAR procedure in place?
field.description: Having a procedure in place provides a written account of how a SAR should be responded to, why it is important they are dealt with and sets the expectations of the individual of how their request will be handled.

field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_ArestaffawareoftheSARprocedure
field.label: Are staff aware of the SAR procedure?
field.description: Any member of staff may be asked for personal data or given a written SAR. It is essential they are aware of the procedure and know how to respond if they receive a SAR

field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_DoesanindividualwithintheschoolhaveresponsibilityforrespondingtoSARs
field.label: Does an individual within the school have responsibility for responding to SARs?
field.description: This member of staff should be aware of the schools' responsibilities and how to handle a SAR. Furthermore, having someone responsible for them ensures the requests will be answered in a timely manner

field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_AreallstafftrainedonhowtorecogniseaSAR
field.label: Are all staff trained on how to recognise a SAR?
field.description: Failure to recognise a SAR could result in it not being answered and the data subject can make a complaint to the ICO

field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_HaveyoucompletedapracticeSAR
field.label: Have you completed a practice SAR?
field.description: Undertaking a practice run will help streamline the process and identify any areas for improvement

field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_Arestaffawareofhowtorecorddatainthebestway
field.label: Are staff aware of how to record data in the best way?
field.description: Recording data correctly, ensuring no excess data is created, data is recorded without identifying individuals where possible and considering redaction in the future will reduce the amount of redaction required

field.name: com_tjucm_subjectaccessrequests_CommentsNotes
field.label: Comments/Notes
field.hint: Type in notes for subject access request checklist
